zh: 合法子串一定是一段连续的 0 接一段连续的 1（或反过来），两段长度相同，因此它恰好跨过原串中两个相邻游程之间的一个边界。
若边界左侧游程长 x、右侧游程长 y，从两边各取 k 个字符（1 ≤ k ≤ min(x, y)）都得到不同的合法子串，所以每个边界恰好贡献 min(x, y) 个。
扫描时维护上一游程长度 previous 和当前游程长度 current：字符与上一个相同时 current 加 1；否则把 min(previous, current) 加入答案，再令 previous = current、current = 1；扫描结束后再加一次 min(previous, current)。空串输出 0。
en: A valid substring is a block of 0s followed by an equally long block of 1s, or the reverse, so it crosses exactly one boundary between two adjacent runs of the original string.

If the run left of a boundary has length x and the run right of it has length y, taking k characters from each side for 1 ≤ k ≤ min(x, y) gives distinct valid substrings, so every boundary contributes exactly min(x, y).

Track the previous run length and the current run length: when a character repeats the last one, extend the current run; otherwise add min(previous, current) to the answer, then set previous = current and current = 1; after the scan add min(previous, current) once more. An empty string gives 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Track the lengths of adjacent runs; each run boundary contributes the smaller of the lengths on its two sides.

## Proof of correctness

A valid substring crosses exactly one boundary between runs of different characters; if the two sides have lengths x and y, choosing k characters on each side works for 1≤k≤min(x,y), and each k is unique. Different boundaries correspond to different substrings, so the sum of the contributions is exact, with no double counting and no omissions.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
